# Elegant Galaxy

> Elegant Galaxy is an Indian home appliance brand founded in 2012. The company makes LED televisions, washing machines, air coolers, and infrared cooktops for Indian households. Products are sold in 500+ cities and serviced through 200+ centres across India, with over 2 million appliances in homes.

Elegant Galaxy is headquartered in India and serves the Indian domestic market. The brand is known for durable, honestly-priced appliances with an 8-year spare-parts commitment and a 24-hour service response. Customer care is reachable Mon–Sat, 9 AM–6 PM IST.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2012
- Country: India
- Market: Indian domestic home appliances
- Product categories: LED TVs, Washing Machines, Air Coolers, Infrared Cooktops
- Distribution: 500+ cities, pan-India dealer and distributor network
- Service network: 200+ authorised service centres
- Appliances in homes: 2 million+
- Spare parts availability: 8 years post-purchase
- Customer care: +91 95406 99333 (Mon–Sat, 9 AM–6 PM IST)
- Sales enquiries: +91 95400 64444

## Products

- [LED Televisions](https://elegantgalaxy.in): Range from 32 inches to 75 inches. HD, Full HD, and 4K resolution. Dolby Audio support, smart connectivity on select models, thin-bezel design. Suitable for bedrooms, living rooms, and home theatres.
- [Washing Machines](https://elegantgalaxy.in): Top-load and front-load models from 6 kg to 12 kg capacity. Wash programmes tuned for Indian clothing types and hard-water conditions. Inverter motor on select models.
- [Air Coolers](https://elegantgalaxy.in): Personal, tower, and desert coolers from 15 L to 60 L tank capacity. Built for India's dry-heat pre-monsoon seasons. Honeycomb cooling pads, multi-speed fans.
- [Infrared Cooktops](https://elegantgalaxy.in): Single and double-burner models. Touch-panel controls, child-lock, 8 power levels. Compatible with Indian flat-base cookware including tawa, pressure cooker, and kadai. No open flame.
